sources_consulted.found: The provisional version published here currently contains the first twenty-eight of the seventy-two chapters of the sūtra, and represents a little under eight of the twelve volumes. Subsequent batches of chapters will be added as their translation and editing is completed.
Opening 13 chapters released 2024, subsequent 15 in early 2025 — total 28 chapters published; team aimed to complete full translation by June 2026 but no announcement of completion found.

reasoning: Toh 8 has 72 chapters spanning 12 Kangyur volumes. 84000 has published only 28 chapters covering just under 8 volumes. Volume 'tha' is the 10th Tibetan alphabet letter, placing it as volume 10 of 12 — well beyond the published 28 chapters. The Sparham 2024 prior is therefore PARTIAL and does not cover the content of our volume tha. Demote is invalid.
